events.title: Waifu Train Is Taking Part in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: We're pleased to announce that Waifu Train is taking part in Steam Next Fest, running from October 19 to 26. We invite you to discover the game and try the free demo!What's in the demo?In the demo, you'll meet Rika Takamine - a housewife who has decided to take a break from her everyday routine. Play through part of her story and try the game's core mechanics: talk to her, discover her preferences, and unlock new possibilities in animated interactive scenes. events.title: Waifu Train Is on Steam!
events.summary: Welcome aboard an unusual train, where every passenger has her own personality, desires, and secrets. Meet the girls, make decisions, develop your skills, and unlock increasingly explicit encounters.Among your future fellow passengers are a housewife tired of the daily routine, a famous pop idol hiding her true nature, a confident TV presenter, and an energetic tomboy.
